description_en: Calls the ListConversationLogs operation to query conversation details
name: ListConversationLogs

parameters.help_en: The session ID, used to identify a visitor's session and maintain context information. For a new visitor, this field does not need to be passed when calling the Chat API for the first time. The chatbot will initiate a session and return the SessionId of the session in the Chat API response. For subsequent conversation rounds of the visitor, pass the current SessionId when calling the Chat API, and the chatbot will continue the conversation based on the SessionId
parameters.help_zh:
会话ID，⽤于标识⼀个访问者 的会话和保持上下⽂信息。对
于⼀个新的访问者，⾸次调⽤ Chat接⼝时⽆需传递此字段， 机器⼈会开启⼀个会话，并在 Chat接⼝的响应中返回该会话 的SessionId。对于该访问者的 后续轮次的会话，调⽤Chat接
⼝时传递当前会话的 SessionId，机器⼈即可基于 SessionId继续该轮次会话
parameters.name: session_id
